dedupe_keys.name: simplified trace of the natran formerly grtgaz gas transmission network france 250 m accuracy 2024 update

description: This data set is a simplified line trace of all pipelines in service on the natural gas transmission network operated by NaTran, the French transmission operator formerly named GRTgaz, qualified at the 1:250,000 scale. It is published on ODRÉ, the Open Data Réseaux Énergies platform of French energy network operators, with 11,615 line records carrying the region and department, and was last modified on 20 June 2025 (2024 update). NaTran states that it tries to update the trace every year, that it is suitable for regional or national scale use, and that sections shorter than 250 m may be missing. Coverage is the NaTran network in mainland France; the network of the other operator Teréga is not part of this trace. Data are free under the Etalab Open Licence 2.0 and can be exported through the Opendatasoft portal and API in the usual geographic and tabular formats. Caveats: the operator gives the trace as strictly indicative, without guarantee of accuracy, and it must not be used for roadworks, where only the national one-stop network enquiry service applies. Simulation uses are national gas network topology for flow models and exposure of transmission pipelines to floods, landslides and other hazards. Related records: data-odre-open-data-reseaux-energies is the platform hosting it, and data-scigrid-gas gives a European gas network model.
